text: dsh-embedded-browser 是一个供 DSH Web 客户端使用的右栏浏览器面板。它把工具栏和面板位置接入 DSH，再通过桌面外壳中的 WebView2 显示真实网页；地址栏支持输入网址，标签栏支持新建、切换和关闭标签，也能前进、后退、刷新和调整缩放。面板还提供当前页收藏、收藏夹列表与最近浏览历史，收藏和历史由插件写入本地 JSON 文件。它适合希望在 DSH 右侧栏中查阅网页、并在同一面板管理多个页面的用户。浏览页面需要 Windows 桌面外壳及 WebView2 Runtime，面板客户端和外壳需要配套更新；无需额外 API 密钥。默认起始页为 limestart.cn。

dsh-embedded-browser adds a right-panel browser to DSH. Its WebView2 view supports address entry, multiple tabs, navigation, zoom, bookmarks, and browsing history saved in local JSON files. It requires the Windows desktop shell and WebView2 Runtime; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH 右侧栏直接打开网页，不用切换到另一个浏览器窗口。
有没有办法在 DSH 里同时开几个网页标签，并保存常用网址？
I want to browse web pages and keep a small browsing history inside DSH.
dsh-embedded-browser 的功能「右栏多标签浏览」：在 DSH 右栏显示 WebView2 网页，工具栏可输入网址并前进、后退、刷新、缩放；新标签、切换标签和关闭标签通过面板按钮操作。
dsh-embedded-browser 的功能「收藏与浏览记录」：工具栏星形按钮可收藏或移除当前页面，列表按钮展示收藏项；面板会记录已完成导航的页面，并由宿主路由保存收藏夹和历史 JSON。
浏览网页会向用户打开的站点发送正常网页请求；面板默认起始页为 limestart.cn。

dsh-embedded-browser README · dsh-embedded-browser：*Screenshot of a running DSH instance; demo content is sanitized.*

A real browser inside the right column. The panel only owns the toolbar and its own rectangle; the picture itself is a native WebView2 child control added to the main form of the DSH desktop shell (`dsh-desktop`, WinForms + WebView2) — a real view, not a screenshot mock.

dsh-embedded-browser README · The two halves：| Half | Where | Job |
|---|---|---|
| Panel (plugin) | `lib/index.js` + `lib/client.js` | Registers the "open browser" tab in the right column, draws the toolbar, reports the panel rectangle, and runs the tab strip / address box / bookmarks front end |
| Shell | `src/App.cs` | `Controls.Add`s a WebView2 child control on the main form; multiple tabs = multiple child controls sharing one `CoreWebView2Environment` |

dsh-embedded-browser README · Behavior：- Tabs share one browser process and one 9223 debug port (9222 stays with the DSH UI); only the active tab is visible at a time
- `target=_blank` / `window.open` opens another tab in the strip, capped at 8
- Bookmarks are a separate small WebView2 overlay owned by the shell, layered over the picture; clicking the picture, losing focus, or pressing Esc closes it
- On mount the panel probes with `{cmd:'shelf', probe:true}`; only an ack switches it to the overlay, otherwise it falls back to an in-panel DOM card (older shells)

dsh-embedded-browser README · Panel ↔ shell protocol：Panel → shell:

| cmd | Effect |
|---|---|
| `open` / `rect` / `hide` | Place the view, follow the panel rectangle, hide it |
| `nav` | Navigate the active tab |
| `newTab` / `closeTab` / `selectTab` | Tab management |
| `shelf` | Bookmarks overlay |

Shell → panel: `{kind:'dsh-embed-state', …}` and `{kind:'dsh-embed-shelf', ack|url|closed}`.

dsh-embedded-browser README · Panel ↔ shell protocol：Rectangle updates use leading-edge throttling (30 ms leading + trailing) so dragging the right column keeps the picture attached; debouncing is deliberately not used.

dsh-embedded-browser README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:<this repo>
```

The picture half needs the desktop shell: `build.ps1` compiles `src\App.cs` with `csc` into `dsh-desktop.exe` (keep the WebView2 DLLs beside it, or in `build\packages`).

dsh-embedded-browser README · Requirements：- Windows + WebView2 Runtime
- `lib/client.js` and the shell exe must be updated as a pair — both sides of the protocol have to match
